failed_attempts.evidence: BackgroundSchedulePool could not obtain 512 threads; the experimental container PID limit is 512.
failed_attempts.resolution: Explicitly reduce background scheduling pools and cap the global thread pool in configs/clickhouse-limited.xml.

failed_attempts.evidence: Every timestamp in the inspected rows was shifted by -8 hours. WSL local offset is +08:00; the driver calls timestamp() on naive datetime values.
failed_attempts.resolution: Attach timezone.utc to canonical naive UTC datetime values before ClickHouse insertion; regression checks epoch second 1373834327.

completed_suites_with_validation_failure.verified_input: Full-row and all-105-column fingerprints matched in all three systems, at both 100000 and 1000000 rows.
diagnosed_differences: MySQL default four-decimal AVG precision fails the pre-frozen tolerance; set div_precision_increment=12 instead of relaxing tolerance.
ClickHouse 24.6 AVG(Int64 UserID) overflows its accumulator; explicitly cast to Float64.
Q23 needs deterministic SearchPhrase tie ordering; Q22 receives the same complete tie handling.
PostgreSQL and RE2/ICU default dot/newline behavior differs on Referer; specify (?s) consistently.
